thread.preview: This is a controlled live-output capture experiment. Do not inspect files or use skills. First say STREAM_COMMENTARY_ALPHA as a progress message. Then run exactly this one shell command: python3 -u -c 'import time; print("STREAM_TOOL_ONE", flush=True); time.sleep(4); print("STREAM_TOOL_TWO", flush=True); time.sleep(4); print("STREAM_TOOL_THREE", flush=True)'. After it completes, write a final response beginning STREAM_FINAL_ALPHA followed by the numbers 1 through 80 in order, separated by spaces. Do nothing else.
